note: Korean night, Hard-first, cap new cards. 事 si6 ×3, then 19 Hard cards (batchim + café), recap Tue 둘/셋 set, then 8 new café/batchim words (넷/다섯 and 빵/컵/얼음/여기요). Write ×3, 7-Q quiz. Say each card aloud before flipping. 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

tasks.title: Read aloud: café order (Hangul first, then check the gloss)

lines.translation: Excuse me. Two breads, please. · 喂，请给我两个面包。

lines.text: 네 개 주세요. 다섯 개 주세요.
lines.gloss: ne gae juseyo. daseot gae juseyo.
lines.translation: Four, please. Five, please. · 请给我四个。请给我五个。
One cup, and ice, please. · 请给我一个杯子，还要冰。
It's delicious. Thank you. Goodbye. · 很好吃。谢谢。再见。

tasks.prompt: Write ×3 then say: 넷 · 다섯 · 네 개 주세요 · 컵 · 여기요. Then read the café lines twice. If you have a minute, one breath: Point → Reason → Example on why 넷 becomes 네 before 개 (same pattern as 둘 → 두).
tasks.script:
Writing: 넷 넷 넷 · 다섯 다섯 다섯 · 네 개 주세요 네 개 주세요 네 개 주세요 · 컵 컵 컵 · 여기요 여기요 여기요.
Lines: 여기요. 빵 두 개 주세요. / 네 개 주세요. 다섯 개 주세요. / 컵 하나, 얼음 주세요. / 맛있어요. 감사합니다. 안녕히 가세요.
Explanation: Point: native numbers often change form before the counter 개. Reason: 하나/둘/셋/넷 shorten to 한/두/세/네 when a counter follows; 다섯 stays 다섯. Example: 넷 → 네 개 주세요 (four, please), not 넷 개 주세요.

questions.explain: Final ㅂ → p, so 밥 is bap. Same rule as 컵 (keop).

questions.q: The final sound in 옷, 셋 and 넷 is…
questions.explain: ㅅ at the bottom of a block sounds like t: 옷 = ot, 셋 = set, 넷 = net.
넷 becomes 네 before 개 → 네 개 주세요. Same pattern as 둘 → 두 개 주세요.
여기요 = excuse me / over here, to call café staff. 叫服务员。
하나/둘/셋/넷 shorten to 한/두/세/네, but 다섯 stays 다섯 개.

options: you are leaving and the other person stays
questions.explain: 가세요 = go. Say it when the other person is leaving. Recycle from Tuesday.
ㅃ is tense pp, and final ㅇ is ng: 빵 = ppang.
